contracts.boundary: Auto allowance recovery requires proof of the first user message for the current agent activity. A second user message, including consumed steering, makes recovery ineligible until agent_settled; missing lifecycle proof fails closed.
contracts.assertions: Real Pi sessions in reliability v1 and v2 execute a synthetic tool, consume queued steering and receive an empty allowance failure without dispatching an alternate; a later independent settled turn still recovers once. Scratch-only removal of the new guard turns the named assertion red in each mode and restores green. Existing queued follow-up dispatch and empty Pi retry controls also pass. A registered-event harness emits the Pi lifecycle and verifies absent lifecycle proof fails closed in both versions.

boundaryTest.name: does not retry a queued steering message after tool activity in v1

invariant.name: does not retry a queued steering message after tool activity in v2

fault.name: proves consumed steering activity blocks replay in v1
